claims: 'SaaS is officially dead' because anyone can paste a site or repo and get a rebuild prompt for free
Setup takes 20 seconds: paste URL or GitHub repo, click Get Prompt, copy into Claude or ChatGPT
Pro tip: ask Claude/ChatGPT to turn the prompt into a full PRD before building so you don't waste tokens building the wrong thing
how_to_steps: Go to the 'Reverse into a prompt' site
Paste any website URL or GitHub repo URL and click Get Prompt
Copy the prompt into Claude or ChatGPT
First ask the model to expand the prompt into a full product requirements document, then build
on_screen_only: Site header 'Reverse into a prompt -- Reverse engineer any codebase or website into a prompt'
Site UI: input box, red 'Get Prompt' button, example chips under the input, generated prompt shown as a long text block with a copy button
Karaoke captions: 'DEAD SOMEONE JUST', 'REPO OR PRODUCT', 'PASTE IN ANY', 'BEFORE BUILDING ANYTHING', 'TOKENS'
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow for more

relevance.why: Haji liked canivibecodeit.com (SaaS directory with rebuild prompts) and clone-site skills. This is the same 'clone a product into a prompt' pattern, generalized to any URL/repo. Useful for scoping a competitor clone or an internal tool quickly.

implement_score.why: Trivial to try (paste a URL). But Claude Code with a /clone-site skill or just 'read this repo and write a PRD' already does this, and the site's URL is not shown. The PRD-first advice is good practice Haji already follows.
